Understanding AI assistants and agents

You direct the project.
AI can help with different parts.

YOUR TEAM

Set the purpose.
Provide context.
Make the decisions.

You decide which suggestions hold up against real evidence.

WHAT YOU CAN DELEGATE WHAT COMES BACK FOR YOUR REVIEW
Research

Sources to check and questions to ask people

Design

Layouts, images, and ways to explain your idea

Build

An interaction or a first prototype to try

Review

Possible gaps, useful tests, and revised drafts

One tool can help in several roles. It still needs your direction and judgment.

UWC Changshu China · November 202605 / 18
Giving useful direction

The quality of your instructions
changes the help you receive.

Example brief · food waste

We want to help families understand what food they throw away.

Help us design a one-week diary that takes two minutes a day.

Ask us what you need to know before making it.

Who it is forWhy it mattersWhat to makeWhat must be practical

Useful direction comes from knowing your project, rather than memorising a special prompt formula.

Choosing tools · Research and planning

Choose the product that matches
the work you want it to do.

ProductUseful starting taskImportant distinction
DeepSeek chatExplain a concept, discuss an approach, or draft code.Code in a reply is not the same as a tested, published app.
DeepSeek HarnessWork on files and run commands or tests in a project.A separate agent product in preview; requires setup.
Kimi Build / 3D MakeDevelop a website or explore a 3D model.Choose the dedicated mode; inspect the actual output.

A tool’s ability to accept images is different from its ability to write and execute code.

Read a story, try a challenge,

UWC Changshu China · November 202609 / 18
Kimi · Choose a building mode

Use Kimi Build for a web app,
and 3D Make for a model.

Your goalProduct and deliverableWhat happens next
A useful web appKimi Build: pages, interactions, and supported persistent data.Try the task, check saved records, then publish when ready.
A 3D concept3D Make: a preview and model files such as STL or GLB.Inspect scale and geometry in the appropriate software.
A more complex projectKimi Code / Work: local project development with connected tools.Get setup support for modelling software or a game engine.

Optional supporting tools: GitHub · code & history; Vercel · publishing; Supabase · data & accounts; Tally · forms. Links in the student guide.

UWC Changshu China · November 202610 / 18
Example · Sustainability

A food-waste project could involve
research, a diary, and a conversation.

Project taskA possible Canva-only routeHow your team checks it
Explain the purposePublish a short website explaining the diary.Can a family understand what to record?
Collect entriesUse a form connected to Canva Sheets; use sample entries first.Does each submission persist after reloading? Who can see it?
Explore the recordsReview the Sheet and create a summary for discussion.Do totals match the entries? What can the data actually tell you?

This is a manually entered tracker. An automatic weighing device would need hardware and additional integration.

Example · Hardware and public benefit

A digital concept helps you explain
what a physical device should do.

CONCEPT STUDY / SOIL-MOISTURE REMINDER

Probe → controller → reminder

AI CAN HELP YOU EXPLAIN

The proposed design

Compare specifications, sketch an enclosure, or simulate the interface.

YOUR TEAM STILL TESTS

The physical reality

Check wiring, real readings, fit, and whether the reminder is useful.

UWC Changshu China · November 202612 / 18
Using the tools responsibly

What would convince you
that the idea actually works?

THE CLAIM
2minutes

“Families can complete
our diary in two minutes.”

A target to test, not a result.
YOUR OBSERVATION SHEET
01

Watch someone try it

Give them the diary. Avoid explaining each step.

02

Record what happens

Time it. Note missing entries and confusing questions.

03

Decide what to change

Keep what works. Simplify the rest, then try again.

UWC Changshu China · November 202613 / 18
When you disagree with the output

Explain what is wrong and ask
for a specific revision.

FIRST DRAFT / FOOD DIARY

Too much to enter

Weight of each item g
Price paid ¥
Food category ⌄
Reason for disposal ⌄
Storage conditions ⌄
Every extra field asks for more effort.
FEEDBACK THAT GUIDES A REVISION
“This takes too long.
Keep three simple entries per day. Explain what information we lose so we can decide whether that tradeoff is acceptable.”
The problemThe constraintThe tradeoff
UWC Changshu China · November 202614 / 18
Explaining your contribution

Keep a record of the decisions
behind the final result.

01

The original idea

Who you wanted to help and why you chose the problem.

02

The AI-assisted draft

What you delegated, what came back, and what you rejected.

03

The tested revision

What real evidence changed and what remains uncertain.

Could you explain why your final version is different?
